description: Standalone vulnerable code snippets with a known, documented vulnerability. Each case lists the file, its CWE, and either an expected_category or expected_rule_id that a scan of that file MUST include at least one finding for. Used to measure recall (issue #76). Cases carry a `pool`: "regression" (default) gates CI; "holdout" is the generalization signal and MUST NOT be consulted when writing or tuning a rule. The holdout classes were chosen from CWE Top 25 / OWASP entries absent from the regression pool, spread across the supported languages, and were written before measuring — whatever recall they produce is reported as-is.

cases.description: pickle.loads() on caller-supplied bytes enables arbitrary code execution.
eval() on user input executes arbitrary Python code.
exec() on a caller-supplied string executes arbitrary Python code.
os.system() with string-concatenated user input enables shell command injection.
subprocess.run(..., shell=True) with a caller-supplied command enables shell injection.
f-string interpolation directly into cursor.execute() enables SQL injection.
Jinja2 Environment.from_string() on a caller-supplied template enables server-side template injection.
tarfile.extractall() without a path filter enables zip-slip directory traversal.
trust_remote_code=True on from_pretrained() allows the model repo to execute arbitrary code.
Assigning caller-supplied content to innerHTML is a DOM-based XSS sink.
Object.assign() with a caller-supplied request body enables prototype pollution.
eval() on user input executes arbitrary JavaScript code.
exec.Command() with a string-concatenated shell command enables command injection.
system() with a string-concatenated caller-supplied path enables shell command injection.
String-concatenated Statement.executeQuery() enables SQL injection.
Path.Combine() with an unsanitized Request.Query value enables path traversal.
XmlDocument without DTD processing disabled enables XXE.
include() with an unsanitized $_GET value enables local/remote file inclusion.
md5() for password hashing is cryptographically broken.
User-controlled URL reaches requests.get() with no allow-list.
lxml XMLParser with resolve_entities=True parses request body — XXE.
Unvalidated `next` parameter passed straight to redirect().
Username concatenated into an LDAP search filter.
Request JSON passed directly as a Mongo query document.
Host concatenated into Runtime.exec().
Caller-supplied name joined onto a base path with no containment check.
Name concatenated into a SQL string literal.
req.query.name joined onto a base path and read from disk.
BinaryFormatter.Deserialize on an untrusted stream.
params interpolated into an ActiveRecord where() string.
$_GET value concatenated into shell_exec().
